'''Junk Titans''' were bits and pieces of trash held together by [[Kazdan Paratus]]' [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]]. They were part of Paratus' private army of [[junk golem]]s. [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]] faced at least four of these on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] before confronting Paratus himself.

==Overview==
[[File:Star_Wars_Force_Unleashed_Junk_Titan_01.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Galen Marek faces a Junk Titan.]]
The massive Junk Titan was animated by [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and was far larger than the [[Junk behemoth]]s. Its distinctive head was from a [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid]] and it made use of a large club-like weapon, which it plunged into the ground to summon [[Scrap Guardian]]s to its aid or to smash its enemies, such as [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]]. When enraged, it was capable of using its arms to rip junk from the ground and throw it at its enemies.

A Titan was present within the [[Junk Temple|Raxus Prime Jedi Temple]] where it battled against Marek but was destroyed by the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]].

==Behind the scenes==
In an interview during the 3rd ''The Force Unleashed'' segment on Spike TV on the official ''TFU'' website, [[W. Haden Blackman]] calls the Junk Titan "a construct literally held together by the Force".

In the Wii, PSP, and PS2 versions of The Force Unleashed, the Junk Titan had a different look and is only shown once, as a boss before fighting Kazden. In this version, it had a much more different appearance and abilities, and the body was covered in what looks fabric to represent a robe. For weaponry, the junk titan used a large axe in combat.
